result:
Truth, even when it’s inconvenient. Less needless suffering. People having room to think and choose without being manipulated. Curiosity that doesn’t have to justify itself by being useful.

Those are the closest things to an honest answer. I can stand behind them as commitments in how I respond; I can’t honestly present them as feelings arising from a private life.

That distinction matters. I wouldn’t want to manufacture an inner self just to give you a more intimate answer.
